title: 음식 이름 읽기 1: 김밥, 떡볶이, 비빔밥
objective: Read food names like 김밥, 떡볶이 and 비빔밥 aloud: make tense sounds after final ㄱ or ㅂ, and carry a final consonant over to a following vowel.
summary: Read popular Korean snack-bar dishes aloud the way Koreans actually say them.

task.title: Read the food names
task.line: Use the tense-sound rule and the linking rule to write, choose or check the real sound of each word.

words.meaning: gimbap (rice and fillings rolled in dried seaweed)
tteokbokki (rice cakes in spicy red sauce)
words.exampleMeaning: The tteokbokki is a little spicy.
This is my first time eating sundae.

letters.as: After final ㄱ, ㅂ turns tight [ㅃ]; ㄲ moves over to 이.
Tight ㅃ with no puff of air, like p in 'spa'.

exercises: Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 떡국 ② 국밥 ③ 미역국
Choose the real sound: ① 잡곡밥 [잡곡밥 / 잡꼭빱] ② 라볶이 [라보끼 / 라뽀끼] ③ 국수 [국수 / 국쑤]
Linking: write how each word sounds: ① 볶음 ② 떡이 ③ 국을
Use both rules. Write the real sound: ① 국밥이 ② 약밥을 ③ 떡국이
